name: LHI
recent: Leong Hup 在 2026 年 11 月 20 日公布季度业绩，净利按年走高至 RM130.09mil。同期，公司执行董事及大股东在闭市期内在公开市场增持股份。此外，公司此前获得暂缓执行 MyCC 与仲裁庭裁决的庭令，相关司法复核仍在进行中。
notable: 2026 年 11 月 20 日公布季度业绩，净利按年增至 RM130.09mil。
执行董事 Datuk Lau Joo Hong 与 Mr Lau Joo Han 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日、16 日及 17 日在公开市场增持公司股份。
公司此前获得暂缓执行 MyCC 与仲裁庭裁决的庭令，以进行司法复核。
risks: 公司涉及 MyCC 与仲裁庭的案件，目前已获暂缓执行以进行司法复核，相关法律程序仍在进行中。
earnings: 最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收为 RM2,207.9mil，按年增长 3.5%，按季下跌 2.5%；净利为 RM101.7mil，按年增长 12.6%，按季下跌 11.6%；净利率为 4.6%，低于上一季度的 5.1%。

recent_en: Leong Hup announced its quarterly results on 20 Nov 2026, with net profit rising year-on-year to RM130.09mil. Meanwhile, executive directors and substantial shareholders acquired shares in the open market during the closed period. The company had earlier obtained a stay against the MyCC and tribunal decision, with the judicial review ongoing.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results on 20 Nov 2026, with net profit rising year-on-year to RM130.09mil.
Executive Directors Datuk Lau Joo Hong and Mr Lau Joo Han acquired shares in the open market on 13, 16 and 17 Nov 2026.
The company had earlier obtained a stay of the MyCC and tribunal decision pending a judicial review.
risks_en: The company is involved in a MyCC and tribunal case, and has obtained a stay pending judicial review; the legal proceedings are ongoing.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was RM2,207.9mil, up 3.5% year-on-year and down 2.5% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM101.7mil, up 12.6% year-on-year and down 11.6% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 4.6%, lower than 5.1% in the previous quarter.
